name: 66.7fm
source:
You come across a calling card. There's a scantily clad woman with a thick fur coat on the front. On the back, there's a scrawled-out phone number and a lipstick kiss. 

"a girl to die for--" 

In 66.7fm, listen in on conversations at the end of the world. Do you have something to confess?

[From [url=https://curricle.itch.io/667fm]itch.io[/url]]
